ACT VII OF 2010
BALOCHISTAN GOATS (RESTRICTION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the
Balochistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959 (West Pakistan Ordinance
No.XLII of 1959)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th. May, 2010]
No. PAB/Legis:
V(7)/2010-223 dated 20-5-2010.-The Balochistan Goats (Restriction) (Amendment) Bill, 2010
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 14th May, 2010
and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 19th May, 2010 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Balochisan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959 (West Pakistan Ordinance No.XLII
of 1959), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title,
extent and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Balochistan Goats (Restriction) (Amendment) Act,
2010.
(2) It extends to
the whole of Province of Balochistan except the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come
into force at once.
